sources_considered.why: Dated primary report describes August adoption by sector, but not the required composition of buyers.
Independent procurement data documents cross-industry participation and explicitly describes sample selection.
Read the page. Its June update and industry adoption measures do not match the August buyer-count denominator or profitability exclusion.

evidence_items.locator: Model market share: Anthropic widens its lead, but overall business AI adoption slows
evidence_items.explanation: Ramp identifies sectors with high adoption rates, including finance and professional services. Rates within sectors do not show those sectors' shares of all buyers, and the report does not apply the startup-profitability exclusion.

Zip's procurement cohort includes multiple industries, while its methodology states that the sample skews toward technology companies. Its trailing-year purchase requests do not establish representative August buyer counts after excluding unprofitable AI startups.

unresolved_gaps: No representative August industry distribution of enterprise AI buyers.
No dataset applies the required exclusion of unprofitable AI startups.
Available sector adoption rates cannot be converted into buyer shares without sector population counts.
Spending concentration among large customers does not establish the industry composition of all buyers.
